title: STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets
abstract: arXiv:2610.00003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. translated_title: STATERA：利用冻结时间管状单元通过零样本仿真到真实迁移实现隐藏质量估计
translated_abstract: 为帧级外观预训练的视觉模型通常难以从运动中推断隐藏的物理属性。我们研究了从短单目视频中对不透明、非对称刚体进行质心定位的问题，在该场景下，自遮挡使表面线索和点跟踪均不可靠。我们提出STATERA，它以基本冻结权重的方式适配预训练视频骨干网络（V-JEPA），并结合轻量级时间管状单元混合器，以预测每帧的质心热图与轨迹。为支持该任务，我们引入HiddenMass基准，包含5万条MuJoCo仿真轨迹以及63个带有物理校准质心真值的真实世界测试序列。在仿真中，STATERA-50K-Sigma将归一化质心误差从41.7%（DINOv2）降至25.2%。在零样本仿真到真实迁移中，我们观察到监督方式存在一个根本性权衡：相位感知的目标可能诱导双峰预测，而相位无关的目标则可能坍缩为……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 提出STATERA方法，通过基本冻结权重的V-JEPA视频骨干网络与轻量级时间管状单元混合器，从单目视频中零样本估计不透明非对称刚体的隐藏质心，并配套发布了含5万条仿真轨迹和真实校准测试集的HiddenMass基准，显著降低了质心定位误差。
en_tdlr: STATERA adapts a mostly-frozen V-JEPA video backbone with a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to zero-shot estimate hidden centers-of-mass of opaque rigid bodies from monocular video, supported by the new HiddenMass benchmark with 50K simulated trajectories and real-world calibrated test sets.
